title: Expose authenticated owner cash-note correction
requirements: Expose POST /api/v1/admin/inquiries/{inquiry_id}/cash-notes/{note_id}/corrections solely as an adapter for OwnerCommandService.correct_cash_note. Accept strict JSON: expected_version, reason, replacement null or exactly {kind RECEIPT|REFUND_NOTE, amount_minor, occurred_at, note}, and optional expected_visit_versions. Do not alter or duplicate core business validation.

Require a valid owner session, exact trusted Origin, application/json, matching X-CSRF-Token and Idempotency-Key before dispatch. Reuse established no-store errors: 401 AUTH_REQUIRED; 403 FORBIDDEN or CSRF_FAILED; 415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE. A malformed inquiry_id or note_id returns 404 without dispatch.

On first acceptance return 200 {data:{command_id,inquiry,changed_visits}}. An accepted identical replay returns exactly the stored data and Idempotent-Replay:true. Strict shape and browser-boundary failures reject before consuming the idempotency key.

Map NOT_FOUND to 404; IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH, VERSION_CONFLICT and CASH_NOTE_SUPERSEDED to 409; RESULT_EXPIRED to 410; EXPECTED_VERSION_REQUIRED and all correction input validation failures to 422 without diagnostics. Keep the existing record-cash-note mapping correct.

Add isolated synthetic PostgreSQL route tests for browser boundary, strict correction body including 500-character reason limit and null/replacement shape, unplanned/planned version cases, null and replacement response effects, replay/mismatch/expiry, superseded and foreign note mappings, audit persistence and status invariance. Never read local .env or configured source database.
Do not modify core, add payments, checkout, webhooks, frontend, migrations, secrets, bot adapters or external calls.
acceptance: A signed-in owner can correct a factual receipt/refund note through HTTP while retaining append-only history and without changing service status.
Browser state, versions and idempotency prevent duplicate or partial corrections and surface safe documented errors.
Focused synthetic PostgreSQL route tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted narrow HTTP adapter over reviewed append-only cash-correction core, with no payment execution or other public surface.
